company.description:
TYBR is a medical device company developing a sprayable hydrogel to keep internal organs scar-free after surgery.

Internal scarring is the #1 complication of surgery, and TYBR's naturally derived solution reduces scarring by 75% preclinically.

It was founded by Tim Keane and Alex Smith in Houston, Texas in 2020,

productsAndServices.description: A flowable, thermally responsive extracellular-matrix hydrogel system applied during tendon and soft-tissue repair to separate healing tissues, reduce adhesion formation, and preserve postoperative mobility.
productsAndServices.name: B3 GEL™ System

aiResearchSummary.text: TYBR Health is focused on developing a sprayable hydrogel to prevent scar formation on internal organs post-surgery. Their research includes systems and methods for delivering multi-component fluids, which involve a device with a tube, mixer, and nozzle. This device is designed to carry and mix components of a fluid separately before application, ensuring precise delivery and effectiveness of the hydrogel. This innovation aims to enhance surgical outcomes by minimizing scar tissue formation.
